title: How overwhelmed are you feeling right now?
intro: Sometimes overwhelm doesn't look dramatic. Sometimes it looks like continuing to function while mentally carrying too much. This quick check-in is designed to help you understand how stress may be showing up for you right now — without judgment.

options.text: Stuck in overthinking and mental spirals

questions.text: When life gets overwhelming, I usually:

options.text: Try to juggle everything at once
Shut down internally or pull away
I can't stop taking care of everything around me
My nervous system can't fully relax
I haven't had a real break in a long time

questions.text: People around me probably see me as:

options.text: Supportive and reliable for everyone else

questions.text: What do you need most right now?

options.text: Emotional support and space to breathe
Permission to focus on yourself too

a.description: You carry too many responsibilities at once and struggle to mentally slow down. Your mind is constantly in motion, managing tasks, people, and pressures that keep piling up.

b.description: You withdraw emotionally or mentally when overwhelm becomes too heavy. Your nervous system is protecting you — but you may need gentle support to reconnect.

c.description: You feel responsible for everyone else's needs and emotions. You give so much to others that your own needs often go unmet.

d.description: You get stuck in overthinking, mental spirals, and nervous system overload. Your mind works hard — sometimes too hard — and struggles to find quiet.

e.description: You continue functioning and performing despite emotional exhaustion. You show up for everything and everyone — but you may be running on empty.
